q: 1. Labour Labour act was introduced/founded in
explain: The Labour Act in Nepal was enacted in 2048 BS to make provisions relating to labor standards, rights, safety, and relations.

q: 2. Who is the chairperson of Central Labour Advisory Board?
explain: As per the Labour Act provisions, the Minister or State Minister for Labour chairs the Central Labour Advisory Board.

q: 3. In Nepal, which of the following act contains the provisions on health and safety of the workers?
explain: The Labour Act specifically outlines statutory regulations concerning occupational health, safety measures, and workplace environments for workers.

q: 4. According to labour act considering health condition is
explain: Under health and working condition mandates, adequate safety equipment, protective clothing, and safe machinery operation standards are specified.

q: 5. Maximum working hour for a labour per week should be
explain: The standard legal maximum limit for normal working hours under the Labour Act is 8 hours a day, totaling 48 hours per week.

q: 6. Workers are not allowed to work contiunously more than
explain: Labor regulations mandate that no worker shall be deployed continuously for more than 5 hours without a minimum rest/lunch interval.

q: 7. The space required for living the worker is 15m³ with considering the maximum height of room above floor level.
explain: For health and volumetric space calculations per worker, room heights above 4 meters are generally not factored in to ensure effective breathing space.

q: 8. Which of the following is not concerned with the authority of Engineers?
options: express an opinion on engineering matter
explain: Divulging confidential information of a client or employer is a direct breach of professional engineering code of ethics.

q: 9. Ethics is the science which deals with
explain: Ethics is a normative science that evaluates professional conduct to distinguish right actions from wrong actions.

q: 10. Profession is defined as
options: types of service to needy people
explain: A profession encompasses specialized knowledge through rigorous training, dedicated public service, and organized occupational practice.

q: 11. The Nepal Engineers' Association was established in
explain: Nepal Engineers' Association (NEA) was established in the year 2024 BS (1968 AD) as a professional body of engineers in Nepal.

q: 12. The number of members in Nepal Engineers' Association are
explain: The executive committee representation structure historically defines core office bearers/members standard groupings in the association setup.

q: 13. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् ऐन, २०५५ लालमोहर र प्रकाशन मिति कुन हो ?
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 received royal assent and formal publication on 2055/11/27 BS.

q: 14. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिष‌द्मा कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन ?
explain: According to the Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055, the executive council is composed of 18 total members including the Chairman and Vice-Chairman.

q: 15. NEC मा NEA मध्ये निर्वाचन गरी पठाएको सदस्यहरुको संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explain: Nepal Engineers' Association (NEA) elects and sends 5 representative members to the Nepal Engineering Council (NEC).

q: 16. NEC मा मनोनित वा निवार्चित सदस्यको पदावधि कति दिनको हुन्छ ?
explain: As per the provisions of the NEC Act, the tenure of nominated or elected members of the Council is 4 years.

q: 17. NEC को बैठकमा कति प्रतिशत भन्दा बढी सदस्यको संख्या उपस्थिपत भएमा परिषद्‌को बैठकको लागि गणपूरक संख्या पुगेको मानिन्छ ?
explain: A simple majority of more than 50% of total sitting members is required to meet the legal quorum for holding NEC council meetings.

q: 18. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् ऐन, २०५५ मा कतिवटा दफा रहेछन् ?
explain: The primary legislation of the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 consists of a total of 38 sections (दफा).

q: 19. NEC अन्तर्गत कतिवटा नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ व्यवसायलाई संलग्न गरिएको छ?
explain: There are 25 recognized main streams/disciplines classified under the technical engineering practice framework in NEC rules.

q: 20. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद्‌को अध्यक्ष पदको लागी न्युन्तम योग्यता कति निर्धारण गरिएको छ?
explain: The minimum educational requirement for appointment as Chairman of the Nepal Engineering Council is a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (along with experience qualifications).

q: 21. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषदले श्री ५ को सरकारसँग सम्पर्क राख्दा कुन मंत्रालय मार्फत सम्पर्क राख्नु पर्ने छ ?
explain: The parent line ministry representing the Nepal Engineering Council to the Government is the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport.

q: 22. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् नियमालवी, २०५७ सम्बन्धी कुन गलत छ ?
options: ने.ई.प.नि, २०५७ को निर्माण NEC ले गरेको हो ।
ने.ई.प.नि, २०५७ को निर्माण NEC ले NEC Act 2055 को दफा ३७ बमोजिम गरेको हो ।
explain: Both statements (a) and (b) correctly reflect how NEC Regulation 2057 was framed under Section 37 authority, making none of the options incorrect.

q: 23. NEC ले इन्जिनियरहरुलाई कति भागमा बिभाजन गरेका छन् ?
explain: NEC categorizes registered engineers into 3 primary classifications: General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Foreign Engineer.

q: 24. As per the NEC Act, 2055 the name of engineers
explain: The legislative categorizations specified for membership registers are General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Foreigner Engineer.

q: 25. NEC Regulation, 2057 is effective from
explain: Nepal Engineering Council Regulations 2057 came into legal force officially on 2057/03/08 BS.

q: 26. The number of countries in which Nepal Engineering Council has recognized the academic institutions are (September, 2013)
explain: According to NEC records up to September 2013, engineering academic institutions across 40 countries were formally recognized for engineering registration.

q: 27. The Engineering Council members consist of the following members
explain: The governing board/council of the Nepal Engineering Council is comprised of 18 executive members.

q: 28. Which one type of membership is not categorized by NEC?
explain: Superintendent Engineer is a promotional departmental designation in civil services rather than a registration category under NEC Act.

q: 29. For the registration of general engineer the amount of fee required is
explain: As specified under the NEC Regulations schedule of fees, the standard application fee for a General Engineer registration is NRs 3000.

q: 30. For the registiration of professinal engineers the amount of fee required is
explain: The official fee for registration under the Professional Engineer category is set at NRs 10,000.

q: 31. For the registration of foreginer engineers the amount of fee required is
explain: Foreign engineers registering to practice in Nepal under Category C/Foreign Engineer are charged NRs 15,000.

q: 32. If the registration of an engineers is cancealed from NEC his name will be registerered or not if engineer is ready to register his name (दफा)-18 NEC, regulution
explain: Under Section 18 of NEC Regulation, re-registration/restoration is permissible subject to meeting council conditions and approval.

q: 33. The minimum qulification required for a general engineer is
explain: To register as a General Engineer with NEC, the baseline academic qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech).

q: 34. The minimum qulification required for a professional engineer is
explain: Registration as a Professional Engineer requires higher educational background, typically specified as Master's degree in Engineering alongside professional practice experience.

q: 35. The minimum qulification & experience required for the registration of foreigner engineers is
options: bacheclor in engg. and 5 years experience
master in engg. and 5 yrs experience
explain: A foreign engineer must possess a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in engineering along with 10 years of professional work experience to register in NEC.

q: 36. The registration book for general and professional engineers is written in Nepali language while for foreginer engineer
explain: The official register for foreign engineers is maintained in the English language.

q: 37. NEC publishes the name of registered engineers each year as well as every forth year. The name of foreigner engineers publish
explain: The published roster of registered foreign engineers is updated and released annually by the Council.

q: 38. NEC act and its regulation..........
explain: The NEC Act was promulgated in 2055 BS and the accompanying NEC Regulations were issued in 2057 BS.

q: 39. Nepal engineering council is an autonomous body formed under NEC act in
explain: NEC was legally established as a statutory autonomous body under the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 BS.

q: 40. Which of the following category of Engineer is not mentioned in Engineering Council rule
explain: 'Chartered Engineer' is a designation used in foreign systems (like the UK) and is not a formal category under NEC rules.

q: 41. Which one is not concerned with the NEC
options: accreditation of certificates of academic qualifications
explain: Granting legal sanction/permission to open academic engineering colleges lies with Universities and Ministry authorities, not NEC direct regulatory mandate.

q: 42. Which one is not concerned with NEC
options: authority of opening engineering college me
explain: NEC focuses on regulating engineering professional registration and academic recognition rather than granting college establishment permits.

q: 43. NEC does not approach for
explain: NEC does not provide direct upgrading routes from Overseer (Diploma) level to Engineer without obtaining an accredited Bachelor's degree in engineering.

q: 44. गैह नेपाली दर्तावाला इन्जिनियरहरुको नाम दर्ता गर्दाको लागी गरिनेछ ।
explain: The standard duration of validity for foreign engineering registration under NEC regulations is up to 3 years.

q: 45. गैह्र नेपाली दर्तावालामा इन्जिनियरको कार्यविधि समाप्त भएपछि काम लगाउने संस्थाको अनुरोधमा परिषद‌ले उपयुक्त ठानेमा एक पटकमाको अवधि भन्दा बढी नहुने गरी जति सुकै पटक पनि त्यस्तो दर्ता नवीकरण गरिदिन सक्नेछ ।
explain: Upon employer request, the council can extend/renew foreign engineer registration for a duration not exceeding 1 year at a time.

q: 46. परिषद्ले प्राप्त भएको रकम वाणिज्य बैंकमा जम्मा गर्दा खाता संचालन कसको नाममा हुन्छः
options: अध्यक्ष वा रजिष्ट्रार र लेखा अधिकृत
explain: The financial bank operations of NEC require joint signatures from either the Chairman or Registrar along with the Chief Accountant.

q: 47. परिषद्मा नाम दर्ता नगराई इन्जिनियरिङ व्यवसाय गरेमा कति रुपैयासम्म जरिवाना गरिनेछ ?
explain: Practicing engineering without mandatory registration in NEC carries a legal penalty/fine up to NRs 3,000 as per Section 31.

q: 48. The abbreviation PWD stands for
explain: In the standard procurement framework context of Nepal, PWD stands for Public Works Directives.

q: 49. Prequilification is not required for any types of firm if the costing to buy an equipment is
explain: Prequalification procedures are exempt for procurement works/goods below 20 million NRs thresholds.

q: 50. The minimum and maximum no. of members in the user's committee should be
explain: According to Nepal Public Procurement Regulations (PPR), a User Committee must consist of a minimum of 9 and maximum of 15 members.

q: 51. प्रत्येक बोलपत्र दाताले बढीमा कतिवटा बोलपत्र दाखिला गर्न सक्छ ?
explain: Under PPR provisions, a bidder can submit only one bid for the same procurement package.

q: 52. What percent of interest is taken for the advance amount paid to the contractor by employer?
explain: Mobilization advance payment extended to a contractor is interest-free against an unconditional bank guarantee; hence 0% interest applies.

q: 53. In case of National Competitive Bidding, the prices shall be quoted in
explain: National Competitive Bidding (NCB) rules mandate that financial quotes and transactions must strictly be in Nepalese Rupees (NRs).

q: 54. The employer's have right to
explain: The employer retains full statutory rights to accept or reject any bid during the procurement process prior to contract award.

q: 55. The number of members in dispute resolution committee are
explain: A standard Dispute Resolution Board (DRB / Adjudication) usually consists of 1 or 3 neutral members.

q: 56. Engineer shall practices:
options: impartial andefficient professional relationship with client, contractor & fellow personnels
explain: Ethical codes mandate engineers to serve with professional integrity, efficiency, and strict impartiality toward all project stakeholders.

q: 57. Engineering ethics is the field of applied ethics and system of moral principles that applt to be
explain: Engineering ethics specifically represents a system of moral standards applied to the actual practice of engineering.

q: 58. Code of conduct is not related with
options: making the advice of the enginerr impartial
making the advice untained by any personal consideration
explain: Building Code is a technical standard document for structural design/construction, whereas ethical Code of Conduct regulates moral professional behaviour.

q: 59. Time extension may need to be granted due to
options: both a) and b) of above
explain: Contractual time extensions are legally justified by employer/purchaser delays or uncontrollable force majeure events.

q: 60. What is the abbreviation used for German Technical Co-operation?
explain: GTZ (Deutsche Gesellschaft für Technische Zusammenarbeit) was the historical abbreviation for German Technical Cooperation (now GIZ).

q: 61. Which action does not fall under the principle of public procurement
options: procurement should be economic and efficient
procurement should be always be lowest cost
information and equal opportunities to all
explain: Public procurement focuses on 'lowest evaluated substantially responsive bid' rather than blindly picking lowest cost regardless of technical quality.

q: 62. The variation exceeding 15% of the contract amount is approved by
explain: Variations beyond 15% historically require Cabinet/Council of Ministers or higher departmental authority approval specified by law.

q: 63. To work for survey, design estimate & supervision of a road project, the consultant has to submit
explain: Consulting procurement (QCBS/QBS) requires dual submission of separate Technical and Financial proposals.

q: 64. Who is the Chairperson of Project Co-ordination Committee?
explain: At the district decentralization level, the Chairperson of the District Development Committee (DDC) chairs project coordination meetings.

q: 65. Who is the Chairperson of Construction Material Rate fixation Committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer (CDO) heads the district-level Rate Fixation Committee for construction materials and labor.

q: 66. Who is the Chairperson of House Rent Fixation Committee ?
explain: Government office house rent valuation and fixation committees are headed by the Chief District Officer (CDO).

q: 67. The bid security shall be forfeited if
options: Bidder withdraws its bid during the period of bid validity specified by the bidder on the Bid form
in case of successful bidder, if the bidder fails within the specified time limit either sign the contract or furnish performance security
explain: Bid security guarantees bid commitment; premature withdrawal or failure to execute contract/performance guarantee leads to forfeiture.

q: 68. Integrity is
options: state or quality of being complete, undivided or unbroken moral soundness, honesty & uprightness
both a) and b) of above
explain: Integrity defines moral soundness, undivided standard of ethics, honesty, and professional wholeness.

q: 69. Code of ethics should be
options: both a) and b) of above
explain: A professional code of ethics must be both clearly comprehensive/precise and act as a metric for moral performance.

q: 70. For the supply of any goods as per aggrement, who is responsible for the all taxes, duties, licence fees and other such levies imposed by the GoN.
explain: Under standard conditions of contract, all statutory taxes, customs, duties, and levies imposed by GoN are borne by the supplier/contractor.

q: 71. The technology applicable for the development in developing countries is
explain: Appropriate technology utilizes local labor, sustainable materials, and cost-efficient processes suitable for developing nations.

q: 72. "Corrupt practice" means
options: offering/receiving anything to influence the action of public official
buy more than one bid document
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Corrupt practice specifically refers to soliciting, offering, giving, or receiving anything of value to improperly influence official actions.

q: 73. "Fraudulent practice" means
options: offering anything to influence the action of public official
buy more than one bid document
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Fraudulent practice involves misrepresenting or omitting facts to mislead a party during procurement execution.

q: 74. Which Ministry of Government of Nepal deals with Civil Engineering group of Nepal Engineering service?
options: Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport
explain: The Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport (MoPIT) serves as the cadre-controlling ministry for Civil Engineering service.

q: 75. Professional code of conduct issued by Nepal Engineering Council has
explain: The professional code of conduct framed by NEC contains 8 core articles governing professional practice.

q: 76. Fundamental principle of Professional Engineering Ethics is:
options: maintain high level of ethical conduct
explain: Engineers are fundamentally bound to uphold professional advancement alongside maintaining high standards of ethical behavior.

q: 77. For the fulfillment of his/her professional duties Engineer should:
options: paramount the health of the public
paramount the safety of the public
explain: Holding paramount public health, safety, and welfare is the foundational rule of all engineering professional practice codes.

q: 78. Five members are elected from Nepal Engineers Association members to represent in Nepal Engineering Council every:
explain: As per election tenure alignment, NEA representatives are elected every 2 years during regular organizational elections.

q: 79. Engineers shall build their professional reputation on the ..........of their services and shall not compete unfairly with others.
explain: The standard canon states that engineers must build professional standing based on the merit of their service.

q: 80. In general, Nepal Engineering Council meeting per year should be held:
explain: Statutory requirements mandate that NEC must hold its council meetings at least 4 times per year.

q: 81. Engineering profession needs cooperation with the profession of:
explain: Comprehensive multidisciplinary projects require cross-functional cooperation across legal, financial, and safety/medical fields.

q: 82. Engineer shall act in such a manner as to uphold and enhance the honor and dignity of engineering profession and shall act with.. for bribery, fraud and corruption.
explain: Ethical regulations explicitly demand a zero-tolerance policy against financial corruption, bribery, and fraud.

q: 83. The registered engineer in Nepal Engineering Council should have to renew their registration in:
explain: General Engineer registration under NEC Act is a lifetime registration and does not mandate periodic renewal (unlike foreign engineers).

q: 84. Engineer shall not disclose, without...............confidential information concerning the business affairs or technical processes of any present or former client or employer or public body on which the serve:
explain: Engineers are ethically forbidden from revealing proprietary/confidential business details without explicit prior consent.

q: 85. The user's committee method of construction is labour intensive with a cost estimate upto (Source:PPR 2064(97)):
explain: As per amended PPR 2064 Rule 97, community labor-based works executed via Users Committees can be awarded up to 10 million NRs (1 Crore).

q: 86. Collusive practice" means
options: offering anything to influence the action of public official
arrangement between two or more parties to achieve an improper purpose including influencing improperly the action of another party
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Collusive practice refers to anti-competitive arrangements between bidders to fix artificial bid prices or manipulate outcomes.

q: 87. Which one is correct with respect to values, morals and ethics?
explain: Values define internal guidance rules, morals reflect personal principles, and ethics form structured societal/professional standards.

q: 88. Ethics as a normative science needs code of conduct and guidelines to maintaining high level of standard of good behavior in the society. This is applicable to:
explain: Normative codes of conduct apply universally across all regulated public professions including law, medicine, and engineering.

q: 89. Prequalification is done
explain: Prequalification (PQ) is executed prior to issuing formal bidding documents to filter eligible, technically capable contractors.

q: 90. According to the Public Procurement Regulation, 2064, Who approves the prequalification criteria?
explain: The technical prequalification document and criteria are approved by the Head of Department (HOD).

q: 91. The purpose of bid evaluation is to determine
explain: Public procurement laws enforce selection based on the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bid.

q: 92. The document announcing to prospective bidder that the owner is ready to receive bids is called -
explain: Notice Inviting Bids (NIB) / Notice to Bidders is the formal public advertisement notifying the market of procurement.

q: 93. The time between ordering of the goods or materials and receiving and placing them into use at the point of need is called -
explain: In supply chain management, lead time is the total duration elapsed between order placement and receipt of goods.

q: 94. Engineering shall act in such a manner as to uphold and enhance the honor, and dignity of the engineering profession and shall act with ........ for bribery, fraud, and corruption.
explain: Engineers must uphold strictly zero tolerance regarding any acts of bribery, corruption, or fraudulent practice.

q: 95. Which is the professional body of architectural and engineering firms is Nepal?
options: Sociality of Consulting Engineering and Architectural firms
explain: SCAEF (Society of Consulting Architectural and Engineering Firms) represents private consulting firms in Nepal.

q: 96. What is EPC contract?
explain: EPC stands for Engineering, Procurement, and Construction—a turn-key contracting model.

q: 97. What is the provision in Engineer Council Act and Regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices Engineering work without registering into the Nepal Engineering Council?
options: Rs 1000 find or imprisonment of 1 month or both
Rs3000 fine or Imprisonment of 3 month of both
explain: Section 31 of NEC Act provides a maximum fine of NRs 3,000 or up to 3 months imprisonment (or both) for unauthorized illegal practice.

q: 98. As per the Public Procurement Regulation of Nepal, 2064, What is the maximum remuneration for consulting services that can be procured directly by a public agency?
explain: Direct procurement limit for consulting services under standard PPR rules is up to NRs 500,000 (5 Lakhs).

q: 99. As per the public Procurement Regulation, 2064 of Nepal, what is the maximum weightage for a technical proposal for consulting services ?
explain: Under QCBS evaluation for consultancy services, technical evaluation score weightage is capped up to 80% (with financial at 20%).

q: 100. For the formation of users committee, members are selected
options: among the people of whole district
among the beneficiaries of the project
by nomination by the chief District officer of the district
explain: User committees must strictly be democratically formed from direct local beneficiaries living in the project impact area.

q: 101. Which of the following an engineer should not follow:
options: act as faithful agent for client
accept compensation from more than one party for same service without the consent of all
indicate client the adverse consequences if judgment is over ruled
undertake only these assignments for which he is qualified
explain: In the provided key, option 'c' is selected, though ethically accepting dual unapproved compensation (b) is also forbidden.

q: 102. During construction price variation clause in a contract applies to
options: increase in cost of important materials only
variation in the cost of material labour and fuel
variation in total cost of the project estimated as lump sum figure
explain: Price adjustment accounts for systemic price fluctuations and inflation effects over extended contract periods.

q: 103. As per the prevalling Public Procurement Acts & Regulations of Nepal, provision of price adjustments is normally to inculpated in civil works contract having project duration ?
explain: Price adjustment provisions are mandatorily included for civil construction contracts having execution periods exceeding 12 months.

q: 104. The sequence of priority in making ethical decision is (from top to bottom)
explain: According to the key provided, option 'b' ranks professional standards followed by organizational, personal, and societal levels.

q: 105. In Nepal, which of the following Act contains the provisions o health and safety of the workers ?
explain: The Labour Act specifically sets forth binding statutory norms for worker safety, workplace sanitation, and health protections.

q: 106. For procurement of works up to 2 million, buy which of the following method is to be considered?
options: by direct labour or direct negotiation
explain: Works up to 2 million NRs are procured through simplified competitive sealed quotation/tender methods under procurement rules.

q: 107. Code of conduct defines
explain: A code of conduct establishes normative guidelines prescribing expected professional behavior ('what should be').

q: 108. Provision for professional code of conduct of engineers in Nepal is made in detail in:
explain: The explicit operational code of conduct for registered engineers is detailed under the Nepal Engineering Council Rules/Regulations 2057.

q: 109. Any Non-Nepali Engineer desiring to work in Nepal may apply for registration under:
explain: Foreign national engineers practicing in Nepal are registered under Category C as defined by the council rules.

q: 110. Procurement of services means:
explain: In the context of the key, option 'd' is specified, while general consultancy/non-consultancy hiring is legally defined under procurement of services.

q: 111. The general experience required for nomination of chairperson of NEC is :
explain: The Chairperson of NEC must have at least 15 years of professional engineering experience following graduation.
